title: Audit
description: Who did what, through which agents, allowed or refused by which rule, and what changed: the audit records in Loki (docs/cluster.md). From the command line: task audit:change -- <change or operation id>.

list.name: user
list.label: Person (regex)
list.description: user.id, as the token or the API server names them. The default .* includes records with no user, such as a refusal of a token that did not verify.

panels.title: Changes
panels.description: Every state a change reached in delivery-mcp: who, through which agents, the operation and the Helm revision. Change ids start again at CHG-0001 after task demo:reset; the operation id is unique.

targets.expr: {service_name="delivery-mcp"} | audit_event=~"change\\..*" | change_id=~"$change" | user_id=~"$user" | line_format "{{.audit_event}}  {{.change_id}}  {{.audit_outcome}}  by {{with .user_id}}{{.}}{{else}}no user{{end}}{{with .actor_chain}} via {{.}}{{end}}{{with .helm_revision}}  revision {{.}}{{end}}  {{.operation_id}}"

panels.title: Refused or failed
panels.description: Refusals and failures in delivery-mcp, chain-sts and Keycloak, with the rule or reason, and the writes the API server refused (401 or 403) with its message.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"delivery-mcp|chain-sts|keycloak"} | audit_outcome=~"refused|failed" | user_id=~"$user" | line_format "{{.service_name}}  {{.audit_event}}{{with or .gen_ai_tool_name .a2a_method}} {{.}}{{end}}  {{.audit_outcome}}  {{with .user_id}}{{.}}{{else}}no user{{end}}{{with .actor_chain}} via {{.}}{{end}}  {{.audit_rule}}"

panels.title: Refused at the gateway
panels.description: Requests the gateway answered 401 or 403, or refused a tool (400): who, which route and tool, and the agents acting for them.

targets.expr: {service_name="agentgateway-proxy"} | http_response_status_code=~"400|401|403" | user_id=~"$user" | line_format "{{.http_response_status_code}}  {{.route}}{{with or .gen_ai_tool_name .a2a_method}} {{.}}{{end}}  {{with .user_id}}{{.}}{{else}}no user{{end}}{{with .actor_chain}} via {{.}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Kubernetes writes
panels.description: Every write the API server recorded (local/kind/audit/policy.yaml), allowed or refused: who, the verb and the object. Releases with Helm and kubectl from this machine show as kubernetes-admin; delivery-mcp's rollbacks as its service account. Not here: writes that failed for another reason (404, 409), and the platform controllers' own writes, which the policy leaves out.

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: Keycloak's sign-in and token events: the session id is the sid every gateway record of that session carries.

targets.expr: {service_name="keycloak"} | audit_event=~"keycloak.*" | user_id=~"$user" | line_format "{{.audit_event}}  {{with .user_id}}{{.}}{{else}}{{with .user_sub}}sub {{.}}{{else}}no user{{end}}{{end}}  client {{.user_client}}{{with .session_id}}  session {{.}}{{end}}{{with .client_address}}  from {{.}}{{end}}  {{.audit_outcome}}{{with .audit_rule}} {{.}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Token exchanges
panels.description: chain-sts's decisions: the token it issued for an agent acting for a user, or why it refused. token.jti joins a token to the gateway requests made with it.

panels.title: Calls through the gateway
panels.description: Every request through the gateway but the MCP protocol's own (initialize, tools/list and the like), which task audit:change leaves out as well: route, tool or A2A method, status, the caller and the agents acting for them. diagnosis-agent's own calls carry its gateway key, not a token, so they name no user; their route names the agent.

targets.expr: {service_name="agentgateway-proxy"} | mcp_method_name!~"initialize|notifications/initialized|tools/list|server/discover" | http_response_status_code!="405" | user_id=~"$user" | line_format "{{.http_request_method}} {{.route}}{{with or .gen_ai_tool_name .a2a_method}} {{.}}{{end}} -> {{.http_response_status_code}}  {{with .user_id}}{{.}}{{else}}no user{{end}}{{with .actor_chain}} via {{.}}{{end}}  trace {{.trace_id}}"
